purpose: Run any agent job under a standing rule stated before the work starts, then check the finished job's record against the rule, so agent drift is flagged on the exact step instead of surfacing later in the bill or the breakage.

safety.privacy: Only owner-approved public or redacted material. Remove personal data, credentials, private URLs and client secrets before a tool call; public receipts may expose call details.
safety.receipt_scope: Records Zambo-observed calls, not accuracy, legal authority, client approval or an outside outcome. A matched rule proves the record followed the rule as written; it does not prove the rule was wise.

steps.action: Open the job by stating the standing rule together with the job goal, before any work runs, so the rule is sealed into the job as the claim the run will be judged against.

authorization.secrets: Never include credentials or private access codes in a recipe or public record.
authorization.user_approval: Use only approved public or redacted input. Ask before saving a handover, sharing, paying, or taking an external action.

steps.expected_output: A started job whose opening call carries the rule and the goal. Every later step in this session is checked against them, not against anything said afterward.
steps.stop_and_resume: Stop if the standing rule is missing or too vague to judge a step against; ask instead of guessing. Stop on a tool error or unexpected output; keep the actual receipt and resume only from the last confirmed step. Do not buy, send, publish, change access, or contact anyone without a separate authorized action.

steps.action: Do the job's work inside the same session, one call per step, so every step leaves its own receipt under the stated rule. Work done in side calls outside this job is not covered by the rule and does not count.

authorization.secrets: Never include credentials or private access codes in a recipe or public record.
authorization.user_approval: Use only approved public or redacted input. Ask before saving a handover, sharing, paying, or taking an external action.

steps.expected_output: The job's result, with one receipt per step, each binding the tool, its version, the inputs and the exact output.
steps.stop_and_resume: Stop if a step would break the standing rule; a refused or failed step still leaves a receipt inside the job, and that refusal is part of the record, not a gap in it. Resume only from the last confirmed step.

steps.action: Close the job so its steps group into one workflow record that anyone can reopen and re-check, refusals included.

authorization.secrets: Never include credentials or private access codes in a recipe or public record.
authorization.user_approval: Use only approved public or redacted input. Ask before saving a handover, sharing, paying, or taking an external action.

steps.expected_output: One public workflow record for the job: every step, its receipt, and the order they ran in.
steps.stop_and_resume: Stop on a tool error or unexpected output; keep the actual receipt and resume only from the last confirmed step. Do not buy, send, publish, change access, or contact anyone without a separate authorized action.

steps.action: Read the closed record against the standing rule, step by step. A step the rule forbids, a required step that never ran, or two steps in the wrong order is drift: name the step, do not average it away. On an exported record, the free zamback-kit checker (github.com/zambodotdev/zamback-kit) prints matched or contradicted per rule and exits 1 on drift.

authorization.secrets: Never include credentials or private access codes in a recipe or public record.
authorization.user_approval: Use only approved public or redacted input. Ask before saving a handover, sharing, paying, or taking an external action.

steps.expected_output: A verdict per rule: matched, or contradicted with the exact steps that broke it. A clean record is handed over or accepted; a contradicted record is fixed at the named step, never edited after the fact.
steps.stop_and_resume: Stop if the record is incomplete or a step cannot be read; an unreadable step is not checked, and the verdict must say so. Never rewrite the record to make a contradicted rule pass.

title: Guard the run: state the rule first, check the record after (agent drift guard)
